text:
Maya Chen: planning public announce + deep-dive webinar on 2025-10-15 09:00am PT. need final changelog URL, docs anchor, bench blurb for hero, and inbound lead routing rules. who owns eng handoff?
Priya Desai: I can own the changelog publish and docs anchor. propose changelog freeze Thu 6pm PT and docs live by Thu 11:59pm PT.
Ethan Brooks: engineering ok with that timeline. will avoid internal codenames in release notes.
Samira Khan: marketing checklist: 1) one-line bench summary + two callouts, 2) blog hero + subhead, 3) tweet variations, 4) signup modal with UTM + lead_tier. will draft once eng confirms numbers.
Linh Tran: tagging release-bot to schedule rolling deploy. release-bot: please schedule canary at announce time with 2h watch.
release-bot: canary scheduled for 2025-10-15T09:00:00-07:00, watch 2h, notify #eng-oncall #eng-sre.
Maya Chen: inbound routing: route signups to Enterprise SDR queue if company_size > 100 OR has finance/healthcare domain. for edu/gov, route to Partnerships. add hidden computed field `lead_tier` on the form.
Samira Khan: will implement `lead_tier` and pass account metadata to HubSpot. need sample field names from eng for the embed form.
Priya Desai: provide fields: account_id, region_hint, plan_estimate. endpoints will return `account_id` when logged-in. for anonymous signups we'll infer region by IP (inferred_region).
Ethan Brooks: bench context: tests on g5.8x at seq_len=512, batch=12, warm KV cache. results: p50 down 9.6%, p99 down 14.2%, token cost down 18.5% using prefix cache + quant-B. note: micro requests (<8 tokens) show unchanged latency.
Samira Khan: marketing will round to "p99 latency ~14% lower; token cost ~19% lower" and include exact test config in notes. good to have the hardware & batch details in the blog appendix.
Maya Chen: webinar CTA: "Register for the 10/17 technical deep-dive" link: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=announce&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=release1809. include hidden params lead_tier & account_id.
Samira Khan: drafting social copy: A) "New release: lower latency, lower cost. Join our deep-dive 10/17: [link]" B) "See how we cut p99 latency ~14% and token costs ~19% 0/17 webinar: [link]". will put both in the doc for editing.
Ethan Brooks: rollout plan: canary 5% at t0, 30% at +40m, 100% at +120m. monitoring: p99, error_rate, latency_distribution. fallback policy: `auto_revert_on_error(1.25x)` and manual rollback window 30m.
Linh Tran: ops note: if error_rate spikes >1.3x baseline in watch window, auto-fallback to previous model. playbook snippet will be in eng-releases.
Maya Chen: timeline recap: Thu 18:00 changelog freeze, Thu 23:59 docs live, Fri 12:00 marketing draft for review, Mon 09:00 beta preflight email, Wed 09:00 public announce + blog + social + webinar modal.
Priya Desai: I will post docs at https://docs.redwood.ai/release/1809#changelog by Thu 23:45 PT and paste link here.
Ethan Brooks: canary playbook link once ready: https://redwood.ai/internal/eng-releases/canary-1809.md (shared with #marketing).
Samira Khan: will post blog + social drafts by Fri noon PT. adding JSON embed sample for blog: ```{ "release": "v1809", "p99_reduction": "14.2%", "token_cost_reduction": "18.5%" }```
Maya Chen: quick stylistic note: no internal codenames in public copy; use benefit-led language. also press/research requests get a prepared appendix with test methodology.
Samira Khan: noted. will include a short methodology appendix and link to raw bench artifacts in the docs.
Maya Chen: final asks: Priya drop final docs link when live; Ethan confirm playbook link; Samira post drafts by Fri noon. we'll sync Mon morning for final signoff. :rocket:
